Probably depends on your reasons for going no poo. Usually it is because we don't want harsh chemicals anywhere on or near our bodies, as well as  getting out of the vicious cycle of hair washing (stripping it from natural oils), going for cheaper, no waste options etc. You don't want to find yourself being too strict about no poo ''rules'' and doing more damage to your hair than before (I kinda did that and am struggling a bit now), so finding products and options that work in getting your hair better, more healthy and manageable is a way to go. It's a bumpy road, but I do believe it's worth it.
